content:
The **Rollins Labor Camp** (formerly **Rollins work camp**) is a location in the Ash Heap region of Appalachia. The area has been turned into a Blood Eagles base.

Built about the base of a towering dragline that is lodged in the earth. The earth surrounding the dragline is still burning and releasing gases into the air. Pre-War bungalows serve as the home of the new inhabitants: members of the Blood Eagles and their Mongrels.

On top of the excavator are a Skeleton, a Missile Launcher, four Missiles, and some grenades. A Power Armor Station is located behind one of the bungalows. Beckett can be found here during the quest Ally: Narrow Escape. He is one of five allies that one can have at their C.A.M.P.

At the top of the crane arm sits a Jangles the Moon Monkey and two Teddy Bears involved in a tense situation. A long rope is coming out of a gas can, subsequently tied to a Toy Rocketship. The rocket toy is positioned directly underneath Jangles. Opposite of the monkey, two Stuffed Polar Bears face it, showing a clipboard. One of the bears holds a flip lighter near the rope.

- Blood Eagles - AshTrey - Holotape, at the top of the main construct of the Blood Eagles, on a table.
- Beckett's Jail Cell Key - In the steamer trunk at the top of the main construct, near the Blood Eagles - AshTrey holotape, during Ally: Narrow Escape.
- Potential Vault-Tec Bobblehead - On top of the roof of the excavator, behind the Skeleton.
- Potential Magazine - At the very back, on the roof of the huge bucket excavator, accessed via the rust-red gantry.
- Power Armor Chassis with T-series armor pieces - In a Power Armor Station behind the southwestern trailer.
- Potential Power Armor mod - In the southwestern trailer, on a lower metal shelf to the right of a set of lockers.

- With patch 1.3.0.23, the location was renamed from Rollins work camp to Rollins Labor Camp.
- As of patch 1.3.1.26, Beckett will not appear in the location when the Ally: Narrow Escape quest is not active.

The Rollins Labor Camp appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.
